alerts.name: SQL Server 实例不可达
alerts.action:
1) 在数据库主机执行 systemctl status mssql-server（Linux）或 Get-Service MSSQLSERVER（Windows）确认服务状态；
2) 服务在跑则用 sqlcmd -S <host>,1433 -U <user> 手工连一次，区分是网络不通、端口没监听还是账号被锁；
3) 服务没起来则查看 /var/opt/mssql/log/errorlog（Linux）或 SQL Server 错误日志，常见原因是磁盘满、tempdb 无法创建、证书过期；
4) 恢复后执行 SELECT name, state_desc FROM sys.databases 确认所有库都回到 ONLINE。

alerts.name: SQL Server 存在 SUSPECT 状态的数据库
alerts.name_en: SQL Server has a database in SUSPECT state
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT name, state_desc FROM sys.databases WHERE state_desc <> 'ONLINE' 确认是哪个库；
2) 查看 SQL Server 错误日志里该库最近的报错，确认是 IO 错误还是日志损坏；
3) 优先用最近一次可用备份做还原（RESTORE DATABASE），这是数据损失最小的路径；
4) 无可用备份时才考虑 EMERGENCY 模式 + DBCC CHECKDB(..., REPAIR_ALLOW_DATA_LOSS)，该操作会丢数据，务必先做文件级快照。

alerts.name: SQL Server 存在 OFFLINE 状态的数据库
alerts.name_en: SQL Server has a database in OFFLINE state
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT name, state_desc FROM sys.databases WHERE state_desc = 'OFFLINE' 列出离线的库；
2) 确认是否是计划内的维护或迁移操作，核对变更单；
3) 非计划的执行 ALTER DATABASE [库名] SET ONLINE 尝试上线，失败则看错误日志里的具体原因；
4) 上线后执行 DBCC CHECKDB([库名]) WITH NO_INFOMSGS 确认数据一致性。

alerts.name: SQL Server 数据卷剩余空间不足
alerts.name_en: SQL Server data volume free space low
alerts.action:
1) 从告警标签取 volume_mount_point，执行 SELECT DB_NAME(database_id), name, size*8/1024 AS size_mb FROM sys.master_files ORDER BY size DESC 找出占用最大的文件；
2) 日志文件异常大的先执行 BACKUP LOG 截断再 DBCC SHRINKFILE，注意完整恢复模式下不备份日志是缩不掉的；
3) 数据文件确实需要这么大的，清理历史分区或归档冷数据；
4) 应急可先把 tempdb 或备份文件迁到其他卷腾出空间，长期需要扩容磁盘。

alerts.name: SQL Server 事务日志使用率过高
alerts.name_en: SQL Server transaction log usage too high
alerts.action:
1) 从告警标签取 instance（数据库名），执行 SELECT name, log_reuse_wait_desc FROM sys.databases WHERE name = '<库名>' 看日志为什么不能重用；
2) log_reuse_wait_desc 为 LOG_BACKUP 的立刻执行 BACKUP LOG [库名] TO DISK='...'，这是最常见的原因；
3) 为 ACTIVE_TRANSACTION 的执行 DBCC OPENTRAN 找出长事务并评估是否 KILL；
4) 为 REPLICATION 或 AVAILABILITY_REPLICA 的去查复制/AlwaysOn 的同步是否卡住，先修复同步链路。

alerts.name: SQL Server 页面生命周期过短
alerts.name_en: SQL Server page life expectancy too low
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT * FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE counter_name LIKE '%Page life%' 确认实时值；
2) 执行 SELECT TOP 20 * FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats ORDER BY total_logical_reads DESC，找出逻辑读最大的语句，通常是缺索引导致的全表扫描；
3) 用 sys.dm_db_missing_index_details 拿到建议索引并评估后创建，这比加内存见效快；
4) 确认查询已优化仍不足的，检查 max server memory 配置是否过小或被其他进程挤占，再考虑扩内存。

alerts.name: SQL Server 存在等待内存授予的查询
alerts.name_en: SQL Server has queries waiting for memory grants
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT session_id, requested_memory_kb, granted_memory_kb, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_exec_query_memory_grants 查看谁在等、谁占着；
2) 对占用巨大的会话用 sys.dm_exec_sql_text 取出语句，通常是大排序或大哈希连接，缺索引会显著放大内存需求；
3) 应急可 KILL 掉占用最大的会话释放内存；
4) 长期按 dm_db_missing_index_details 建索引、拆分大查询，或调大 max server memory。

alerts.name: SQL Server 阻塞进程数过高
alerts.name_en: SQL Server blocked process count too high
alerts.action:
1) 执行 SELECT blocking_session_id, session_id, wait_type, wait_time, wait_resource FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0 找出阻塞链的源头；
2) 对源头 session 用 DBCC INPUTBUFFER(<spid>) 或 sys.dm_exec_sql_text 看它在执行什么；
3) 确认是失控的长事务后执行 KILL <spid> 先止血；
4) 事后检查该事务是否缺少索引导致锁范围过大，或应用侧忘记提交事务，必要时评估启用 READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT 降低读写互斥。

alerts.name: SQL Server 发生死锁
alerts.action:
1) 执行 system_health 扩展事件查询死锁图：SELECT XEvent.query('.') FROM (SELECT CAST(target_data AS XML) AS TargetData FROM sys.dm_xe_session_targets ...) 取出 xml_deadlock_report；
2) 从死锁图里看两个事务的加锁顺序与涉及的索引；
3) 最常见的修法是统一业务代码里多表更新的顺序，以及给参与的查询补索引缩小锁范围；
4) 短期可在应用侧对死锁错误号 1205 做自动重试，但不能替代根因修复。

alerts.name: SQL Server 数据文件读延迟过高
alerts.name_en: SQL Server data file read latency too high
alerts.action:
1) 从告警标签取 database_name 与 logical_filename，定位是哪个库的哪个文件慢；
2) 在主机侧执行 iostat -x 1（Linux）或用性能监视器看 Avg. Disk sec/Read，确认是存储本身慢还是 SQL Server 读放大；
3) 存储正常则按 Page Life Expectancy 的思路优化查询、补索引，减少物理读；
4) 存储确实慢的，考虑把该文件迁到 SSD、拆分文件组分散 IO，或排查是否与备份任务错峰不当。

alerts.name: SQL Server 数据文件写延迟过高
alerts.name_en: SQL Server data file write latency too high
alerts.action:
1) 从告警标签取 database_name 与 file_type，file_type=LOG 的优先处理，日志写慢会直接卡住所有提交；
2) 主机侧用 iostat -x 1 看该磁盘的 await 与 %util，确认是否已打满；
3) 日志文件与数据文件放在同一块盘的，把日志迁到独立的低延迟磁盘；
4) 检查是否有备份、DBCC CHECKDB、索引重建等重 IO 任务与业务高峰重叠，调整到低峰执行。

collect.content:
# # collect interval
# interval = 15

[[instances]]

## Specify instances to monitor with a list of connection strings.
## All connection parameters are optional.
## By default, the host is localhost, listening on default port, TCP 1433.
##   for Windows, the user is the currently running AD user (SSO).
##   See https://github.com/denisenkom/go-mssqldb for detailed connection
##   parameters, in particular, tls connections can be created like so:
##   "encrypt=true;certificate=<cert>;hostNameInCertificate=<SqlServer host fqdn>"
# servers = ["Server=server.xxx.com;Port=1433;User Id=monitor;Password=xxxxxx;app name=categraf;log=1;"]
# servers = [ ]

## Authentication method
## valid methods: "connection_string", "AAD"
# auth_method = "connection_string"

## "database_type" enables a specific set of queries depending on the database type. If specified, it replaces azuredb = true/false and query_version = 2
## In the config file, the sql server plugin section should be repeated each with a set of servers for a specific database_type.
## Possible values for database_type are - "SQLServer" or "AzureSQLDB" or "AzureSQLManagedInstance" or "AzureSQLPool"

database_type = "SQLServer"

## A list of queries to include. If not specified, all the below listed queries are used.
include_query = []

## A list of queries to explicitly ignore.
exclude_query = ["SQLServerAvailabilityReplicaStates", "SQLServerDatabaseReplicaStates"]

## Queries enabled by default for database_type = "SQLServer" are -
## SQLServerPerformanceCounters, SQLServerWaitStatsCategorized, SQLServerDatabaseIO, SQLServerProperties, SQLServerMemoryClerks,
## SQLServerSchedulers, SQLServerRequests, SQLServerVolumeSpace, SQLServerCpu, SQLServerAvailabilityReplicaStates, SQLServerDatabaseReplicaStates,
## SQLServerRecentBackups



## Following are old config settings
## You may use them only if you are using the earlier flavor of queries, however it is recommended to use
## the new mechanism of identifying the database_type there by use it's corresponding queries

## Optional parameter, setting this to 2 will use a new version
## of the collection queries that break compatibility with the original
## dashboards.
## Version 2 - is compatible from SQL Server 2012 and later versions and also for SQL Azure DB
# query_version = 2

## Toggling this to true will emit an additional metric called "sqlserver_telegraf_health".
## This metric tracks the count of attempted queries and successful queries for each SQL instance specified in "servers".
## The purpose of this metric is to assist with identifying and diagnosing any connectivity or query issues.
## This setting/metric is optional and is disabled by default.
# health_metric = false

## Possible queries across different versions of the collectors
## Queries enabled by default for specific Database Type

## database_type =  SQLServer by default collects the following queries
## - SQLServerPerformanceCounters
## - SQLServerWaitStatsCategorized
## - SQLServerDatabaseIO
## - SQLServerProperties
## - SQLServerMemoryClerks
## - SQLServerSchedulers
## - SQLServerRequests
## - SQLServerVolumeSpace
## - SQLServerCpu
## - SQLServerRecentBackups
## and following as optional (if mentioned in the include_query list)
## - SQLServerAvailabilityReplicaStates
## - SQLServerDatabaseReplicaStates

## Version 2 by default collects the following queries
## Version 2 is being deprecated, please consider using database_type.
## - PerformanceCounters
## - WaitStatsCategorized
## - DatabaseIO
## - ServerProperties
## - MemoryClerk
## - Schedulers
## - SqlRequests
## - VolumeSpace
## - Cpu

## Version 1 by default collects the following queries
## Version 1 is deprecated, please consider using database_type.
## - PerformanceCounters
## - WaitStatsCategorized
## - CPUHistory
## - DatabaseIO
## - DatabaseSize
## - DatabaseStats
## - DatabaseProperties
## - MemoryClerk
## - VolumeSpace
## - PerformanceMetrics
